The accused driver was identified as 41-year-old Jamuna Ram of Chandar Bigha village under the Barun police station area of Aurangabad district.
His two associates were identified as 32-year-old Arvind Kumar and 42-year-old Nanhak Ram.
The girl had gone to her paternal aunt's house in Banjari before Diwali and was returning home to Tilouthu on Tuesday evening.

items.title: Kerala Mental Health Centres To Be Called 'Institute For Happiness, Wellness'
points: Kerala's government-run mental health centres are set to get a new identity, with the state finalising the name 'Regional Institute for Happiness and Wellness' for its three major institutions in Thiruvananthapuram, Thrissur and Kozhikode.

The Kerala government informed the High Court on Tuesday that the new name had been finalised following consultations with stakeholders, including medical organisations that had raised objections to an earlier proposal.
The development comes with roots in a case dated back to 1996.
Jaju Babu told a Division Bench comprising Justices Devan Ramachandran and Basant Balaji that a formal Government Order was being issued.
On the shortage of personnel, the government sought another fortnight, explaining that the newly appointed Health and Family Welfare Secretary needed additional time to examine the relevant files.
The renaming proposal had earlier triggered objections from the Indian Medical Association and the Indian Psychiatric Society when the government suggested the title 'Happiness and Wellness Centres'.
The revised name, 'Regional Institute for Happiness and Wellness', was finalised following those consultations.

points: The Election Commission of India (ECI) sources have firmly rejected allegations of vote mismatches and possible rigging in the 2024 Haryana Assembly elections, describing claims of large gaps between votes cast and votes counted as based on a basic…

Referring to assertions that in seats such as Badkhal, the number of votes polled far exceeded those counted on electronic voting machines (EVMs), ECI sources pointed to the commission's Assembly constituency (AC)-wise voters information for the 2024…
The figures align completely; the widely circulated "3.32 lakh votes polled" figure is simply the total number of voters on the electoral rolls, not the number who voted.
The biggest such discrepancy is in Maharashtra's Mumbai North Parliamentary constituency, reports said.

According to the ECI's internal records, reports alleged, total votes polled were 18.11 lakh in the constituency, but according to the result declared by the Commission, 10.33 lakh votes were cast in the constituency.

items.title: No, Periyar did not quit Congress in 1925

Over the years, its patronage plummeted due to piracy off the Somalia coast that deterred seafarers and the marina’s inadequate depth due to dredging not being done at frequent intervals, to name a few.

In her vlog, Ms. Amrutha, who once sailed from the marina to Djibouti — a country on Africa’s eastern coast, shows swathes of water hyacinth beside the marina’s vacant ramps (verified by The Hindu on November 10, 2026) and rues that “people do not see the…

items.title: Register FIR in public library book ‘scam’ case, Madras HC directs DVAC
points: Hearing a contempt petition filed in this regard, a Division Bench of Justices G.R.

Sumathi directed the Director of Public Libraries to make available the names and details of officials who were responsible for allegedly making fraudulent procurements of so-called books during the last two years and more, so that they could be impleaded…
“The First Bench of the Madras High Court, comprising Justice R.
Mahadevan (As His Lordship then was) and one of us (Justice Swaminathan) on June 19, 2024, disposed of a writ petition pertaining to the procurement of books for public libraries.
When this Court had passed certain categorical directions on June 19, 2024, as to how the public procurement of books should take place, it ought to have been complied with in letter and spirit.
In fact, our order merely echoed the values underlying the Tamil Nadu Public Libraries Act (TN Act 24 of 1948) and the rules framed,” the judges said.

items.title: Government: Our strong relationship has bipartisan support in US
points: The India-US relationship has bipartisan support on the US side and New Delhi will continue to focus on strengthening the bilateral strategic partnership, the external affairs ministry said in its first reaction to the sweeping victory of the Democratic…

The Democrats wrested control of both the US Senate and the House of Representatives, dealing a blow to the Republican Party, whose fortunes were affected by the growing unpopularity of President Donald Trump over his economic policies and the war with Iran.

External affairs ministry spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal described the mid-term elections as “an internal matter of the US” and told a regular media briefing that India’s focus will remain on strengthening the overall relationship with the US.
Jaiswal responded to another question on the Indian government’s hiring of lobbying firms in the US by describing it as a “normal practice” since 1948.
India has been engaging lobby firms in Washington DC since 1948,” he said.

items.title: MCC also applies to retired govt servants engaged by states: ECI
points: Restrictions under the model code of conduct for government servants are applicable to retired officials engaged by state governments, the Election Commission said.

The letter referred to ECI instructions issued in 1984 and 1991, which state that government employees must not campaign or lend their names, official position or authority to help one party or candidate over another.

Its 2022 pre-poll instructions to the same five states said officials on extension of service or re-employed in various capacities, except those in the office of the chief electoral officer, would not be associated with election-related work.
A similar clarification was issued in the Commission’s January 2019 transfer guidelines.

Before the 2024 Lok Sabha elections in Haryana, a complaint was filed against Rajesh Kumar Khullar, a former IAS officer and the chief principal secretary to the chief minister, alleging “blatant violation” of ECI guidelines on re-employed officials.

items.title: Matrimony.com to acquire 50% stake in astrology tech firm Astro-Vision, reports Q2 PAT up nearly 3X
points: Murugavel Janakiraman, Chairman and Managing Director, Matrimony.com | Photo Credit: BIJOY GHOSH The Board of online matchmaking platform Matrimony.com, on Tuesday, approved the acquisition of an additional 50 per cent stake in astrology firm Astro-Vision…
Matrimony already holds 26.09 per cent stake in Astro-vision, and the total stake goes up to 76.09 per cent with this acquisition.
Astro-Vision has been a pioneer in providing vedic based astrology solutions, and recorded a revenue of ₹20.57 crore in FY26.
“Astrology is core to match-making business of Matrimony.com Ltd and majority of its customers generate horoscope prediction using Astro-Vision’s software.
“The Astro-Vision portal has around 40,000 daily visitors and creates more than 25,000 reports per day.

Separately, on Tuesday, Matrimony.com reported a profit after tax (PAT) of ₹21 crore for the quarter ended September 2026 (Q2 FY27), up nearly 3x from the ₹7.8 crore it posted in the same quarter last year.
Revenue from operations went up 18.4 per cent at ₹135 crore (₹115 crore).
